title: Build Visual Novels in one prompt
author: iwantofftheride00

comments.author: iwantofftheride00
comments.body:
Hello. The project is [https://miku.gg](https://miku.gg) . Where you can play and create "generative visual novels".  
I basically implemented an assistant that can create such novels with just one prompt while also doing image generation. You can play the demo generated in the video here: [https://miku.gg/narration/?novel=3a0c7417-1f23-4754-aa38-96284ab2ecf8](https://miku.gg/narration/?novel=3a0c7417-1f23-4754-aa38-96284ab2ecf8)  
  
Most of the project is already open source. The assistant has the prompt open sourced in [https://github.com/miku-gg/miku/blob/master/apps/services/src/services/assistant/systemPrompt.mts](https://github.com/miku-gg/miku/blob/master/apps/services/src/services/assistant/systemPrompt.mts)
